in_hebrew.name: Bedad
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Servant of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bedad הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew 'bededet', meaning 'servant of God'. In the Bible, Bedad is a name mentioned in the Old Testament, belonging to a warrior in King David's army.

in_greek.name: Bedad
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Servant of God
in_greek.long_meaning: Bedad είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew 'bededet', meaning 'servant of God'. In the Bible, Bedad is a name mentioned in the Old Testament, belonging to a warrior in King David's army.

in_latin.name: Bedad
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Servant of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Bedad est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew 'bededet', meaning 'servant of God'. In the Bible, Bedad is a name mentioned in the Old Testament, belonging to a warrior in King David's army.
